connector.name: Torify - Japan Locale APIs for AI Agents

connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace dev.torify. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
